profile_summary: Mid-life German gardener, no science background, medium patience, does not give up but loses the thread easily on abstract concepts.
followed_seeds: Can you show a worked example where the net force is not zero?
How is inertia related to mass, and is it the same as weight?

offer_responses.seed: How do you add or subtract velocities that point in different directions?
offer_responses.why_short: Greta had just stalled on direction and the plainer framing looked helpful, so she tried it — but the arrow diagram still confused her and she stepped back out.

offer_responses.seed: What if there are three forces instead of two?
offer_responses.why_short: She felt two forces were already enough to manage and did not want to add more complexity mid-session.

stalls.description: Lost thread when velocity was described as having both a size and a direction; kept conflating it with speed.
Momentary confusion over why two forces can cancel to zero — resolved after a concrete gardening-hose analogy was offered.
